values.note: Check-in and check-out are 3 pm. After a stay, 48 hours off state forest land before camping again.

note: A small open pad right beside Bear Wallow Road, about 0.6 mile from Dry Run Road and next to the gated Browns Road (do not block the gate). The agency says the site was not designed for RVs, though its campsite map layer calls it suitable for a large trailer or RV; the pad is listed as 39 by 20 ft. From PA 87 the way in is Elk Creek Road, Hoagland Branch Road and Dry Run Road, which climbs at about 8 to 9% for 0.9 mile with short pitches near 13%; forest roads for dry weather. No toilet. Pack out trash. --Claude
summary: Site page re-read: 400 still listed, Drive-In, RV/Tent/Trailer categories, 30 ft, open overhead, back-in gravel 62 ft graded Slight. Season changed to January-June (resting rotation); not on sale until 1 January. Fees confirmed, $6.50 fee added; pull_through false; facilities none. Imagery: a pad about 10 x 15 m on the inside of a bend, 10 m from the road edge, pin on it; not moved. Access: Dry Run Road 8-9% for 1.4 km: at or under the yardstick. NHD: Little Swamp Run 145 m.
flags: SEASON CHANGED year_round true -> opens 01-01, closes 06-30: DCNR's Loyalsock camping page rests every designated campsite for six months a year (even numbers open 1 January - 30 June, odd numbers 1 July - 31 December) and the booking calendar follows it to the day. The site page still says 'Status: Open year round'. January-March inside the open half is unplowed ('access is not guaranteed'). No status written: the July-December block is the stated rotation.

DCNR GIS layer (2022 record) describes the site as 'Open site adjacent to road. Tent or lage trailer/RV [sic]'; the booking page lists RV Site and Trailer Site with the length written. 'Equipment: Although RVs, Camper Trailers and Tent (Pop-up) Trailers are allowed on this site, the site was not designed for such use and may not be appropriate for some equipment. Check site dimensions, site layout, and overhead clearance' (both in the note).

Access road: PA 87 > Elk Creek Road (SR 4001) 2.0 mi > Hoagland Branch Road 2.9 mi > Dry Run Township Road 1.5 mi > Bear Wallow Road 0.5 mi (OSRM, matches the page). 3DEP: two adjoining runs on Dry Run Road, 8.1% for 800 m and 8.9% for 600 m (steepest 200 m 12.8%); 9.3% over the steepest 1.2 km. A little under Spade Road (~10% over 1.2 km, 14% finish): kept with the dry-weather caveat and grade in the note. Surfaces not confirmed.
Waterfront: stays not waterfront. NHD: Little Swamp Run (intermittent) 145 m.
